title: Write a melody
intro: A melody is notes placed in time. The second number says when each note starts. An optional third number says how long it rings, in seconds.
Here is the start of a very old folk tune. Lines that begin with // are comments: the computer ignores them, they are notes for people.
task: Finish the tune or write your own. Press Ctrl+Enter to run without leaving the keyboard.
hint: Each beat here is 0.5 seconds. Use smaller numbers for a faster tune.
